page_title: LEN 1-0 AUX | Lens v Auxerre 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Assane Diousse (Auxerre) is booked.
90+4' Romain Faivre (Auxerre) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
90+3' Abdallah Sima (Lens) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
90+3' What a sweet touch by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Donovan Leon to hold.
90+2' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
87' It's time for a substitution. Sekou Mara (Auxerre) comes on in place of Danny Namaso.
87' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Assane Diousse (Auxerre) replaces Oussama El Azzouzi.
87' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
86' A substitution has been made. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
83' Samson Baidoo (Lens) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
83' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner.

83' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mamadou Sangare (Lens) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Donovan Leon pulls off a brilliant save.
81' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.

80' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
79' A long ball forward to Rudy Matondo (Auxerre) is intercepted.
76' It will be a substitution. Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is ready to enter the pitch as Saud Abdulhamid walks off.
76' Christophe Pelissier prepares a substitution. Naouirou Ahamada is replaced by Romain Faivre (Auxerre).
76' That's the end of the game for Kevin Danois, who is replaced by Rudy Matondo (Auxerre).
73' A great run from Florian Thauvin (Lens) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just over the bar.
71' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
69' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) commits a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement. Auxerre have a free kick.
67' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
65' The substitution is prepared. Josue Casimir (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marvin Senaya.
65' The substitution has been made. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) has replaced Wesley Said.
65' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Wesley Said (Lens) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
64' Florian Thauvin (Lens) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
62' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
60' Marvin Senaya (Auxerre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
59' Abdallah Sima (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
56' The manager makes a subsitution with Mamadou Sangare (Lens) coming on for Adrien Thomasson.
56' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Rayan Fofana and he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
55' CHANCE! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Matthieu Udol.
55' Lamine Sy (Auxerre) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
54' Danny Namaso (Auxerre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to Clement Akpa (Auxerre) for his blatant foul.
50' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) takes the corner which is cleared.
48' Matthieu Udol (Lens) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
48' Matthieu Udol (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Bastien Dechepy has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
43' Auxerre hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
40' The free kick into the penalty area from Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) is cleared.
37' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
35' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Andrija Bulatovic (Lens). Bastien Dechepy saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Auxerre.
33' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked.
31' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Risser intercepts the ball.
29' 52:48 – the latest ball possession ratio.
27' The game has begun to heat up. Kevin Danois (Auxerre) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) was quite harsh and Bastien Dechepy didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
21' Lens are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
18' Florian Thauvin (Lens) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' The free kick is delivered by Kevin Danois (Auxerre) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
17' Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight and sees a foul from Adrien Thomasson (Lens). It's a free kick to Auxerre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
16' Half-chance! Kevin Danois (Auxerre) plays a pass into the box, but Robin Risser reacts well to snuff out the attack.
16' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
14' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
13' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
12' Auxerre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Rayan Fofana (Lens) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
9' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

8' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Donovan Leon thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
6' Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
3' Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) sends a low pass into the box, towards Danny Namaso. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
2' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
